repo_notes.author: Meridian Labs
repo_notes.content: Start with AGENTS.md and README.md. The current visitor interface is demo-web/, served locally by showcase_demo.py via src/workflow_portfolio/web_demo.py. Earlier Python engines and benchmarks remain separate. Distinguish prepared browser outputs from original recorded model comparisons. Public guides describe separate private apps; their code and personal data are absent. Follow docs/repo-explorer.md for evidence boundaries.
